items.title: American Express (AXP) Brings Global Basketball Perks To Card Holders Worldwide
items.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) announced a major global expansion of its NBA, WNBA, and USA Basketball partnerships, adding new international activations. The broadened agreement introduces first-time overseas fan programs and card member experiences linked to league events and USA Basketball activities.
